name: @brainstorm-os/native-image
description: Native NAPI-RS image addon for Brainstorm — thumbnail derivation for the eager asset tier (Asset-B4b). Separate from @brainstorm-os/native (image decoders never link into the crypto binary) and from @brainstorm-os/native-embed (thumbnails must exist in dev/CI where the release-only ONNX addon is absent). See docs/implementation-plan.md §Asset-B4b.

scripts._build:all_doc: Documentation only — the CI matrix cross-compiles per-runner (13.1c pattern); local cross-compile needs the matching toolchain per the napi-rs CLI's --cross-compile flag.
scripts.build:all: bun run build:darwin-x64 && bun run build:darwin-arm64 && bun run build:windows-x64 && bun run build:windows-arm64 && bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64
scripts.test: bun run build:debug && bun --bun vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
